phase: Phase D.1 — Faithfulness-First Hybrid Retrieval Engineering
warnings: WARNING-01: Cross-encoder static thresholding (tau=-2.0) failed on 3 fictional entity cases containing valid clinical framing words (SR-01 Zephastin, SR-02 Virokine, SR-03 Pulmoflux). Requires upstream lexical entity verification in Phase D.2.
